name: 14 Millrace Row
amenities: River view from the back bedroom|Walk-up attic storage|Original stair|Alley access
summary: A mill cottage on the race, with a steep gable to the street and the Fenwater at the back fence.
body:
14 Millrace Row is one of a short row of mill cottages built in the 1890s. The plan is narrow and honest: a straight stair, a living room at the front, and three small bedrooms under the roof.

The back bedroom looks over the race. The yard is short, but it ends at the water, and the alley takes you to the mill bridge in two minutes.

Taxes are listed on the sheet. There is no association. Showings are by appointment; call the office or come to the Saturday open house.
private_remarks: Seller is relocating in January and will look at clean offers from mid-December. The roof was done in 2021; the previous inspection flagged the chimney cap, which has been replaced. Prefer a closing after the new year.

name: 27 Willow Steps
amenities: Corner loft in the mill|River windows|Deeded parking stall|Shared laundry on the floor
summary: A corner loft on the second floor of the 1884 mill, with windows down the race.
body:
This is one of the 1990s loft conversions in the mill, a corner unit with the original post-and-beam grid left in place.

Two bedrooms sit behind a half wall at the river end. The association covers the stair, the roof, and the parking stall in the old loading yard.

Open house is Sunday afternoon. There is no form on this site; call the office to walk through at another time.
private_remarks: HOA minutes are in the file. Special assessment for the loading-yard drainage was paid in 2025. Seller would like a two-week rent-back if possible.

name: 41 West Common
amenities: Alley garage|Maple in the front yard|Original fireplace|Attic dormer
summary: A classic Common foursquare under a hip roof, with four bedrooms and a garage on the alley.
body:
41 West Common is the house a lot of people mean when they say they want a foursquare: a full porch, a hip roof, and four rooms up, four rooms down.

The kitchen was opened through to the dining room in 2018, carefully enough that the original trim still lines up. The attic dormer is unfinished storage.

Saturday open houses run through the month. The elementary school is a short walk down Orchard End.
private_remarks: Listed a little high at the start; seller is now in line with the last two foursquare sales on the block (see 58 and 72, both sold in September). Inspection from 2018 is in the packet and should be updated.

name: 8 Lintel Street
amenities: Offset porch|Fenced back garden|Alley garage|Original built-ins
summary: A West Common foursquare coming to market at the end of the week, with an offset porch and a fenced garden.
body:
8 Lintel Street will be on the market Friday. The sellers are finishing paint and a few repairs, and the first public open house is Sunday.

It is a slightly smaller foursquare than 41 West Common, with an offset porch and a deep, already-fenced garden.

You can call the office to be added to the first-look list; there is no sign-up form on this site.
private_remarks: Coming Friday. Broker tour is Wednesday 10–12 (this is the weekday open house on the board). Seller wants to be in contract before the school break if possible.

name: 110 Ridge Lane
amenities: Two finished dormers|View of the mill clock|One-car garage|A double lot
summary: A ridge cape with both dormers finished and a view back over the mill roof.
body:
110 Ridge Lane sits on a double lot, which is unusual this far up the hill, and both dormers are finished bedrooms with a second bath between them.

From the upper west window you can see the mill clock. The garage is a later addition and sits at the side, not on an alley.

Open house is Saturday. The high school bus stops at Pinion Street, a short walk down the lane.
private_remarks: Lot is two original parcels; title is already combined. The garage slab has a hairline crack that has been stable since 2019. Sellers are moving to the county seat and are flexible on closing.

name: 3 Pinion Court
amenities: Carport|Band of west windows|Original kitchen counters|View over town
summary: A mid-century ranch on the upper court, low to the ground, with a carport and a west-facing window band.
body:
3 Pinion Court is one of the dozen ranches built on the upper ridge in the early 1960s. The plan opens to the view at the back and keeps a quieter face to the court.

The carport is original. The kitchen counters are too, in a condition that most buyers will either love or plan to change.

Showings are by appointment through the office.
private_remarks: Kitchen and baths are original and priced that way. A 2024 inspection is in the file; the roof was done in 2020. Seller has already bought in another town and is motivated, but not in a hurry to take a low offer.

name: 19 Ferry Green
amenities: Front porch facing the green|Original wood floors|Fenced side yard|Walk to the landing
summary: A Ferry Green bungalow with its porch aimed at the green and a short walk to the old landing.
body:
19 Ferry Green faces the green itself, which is the lot everyone asks for first. The porch is deep enough for a table, and the living room sits right behind it.

Three bedrooms are on the one floor, with a later half bath off the back hall. The river path is a block away.

Saturday open house, 1 to 3. Priya Sandoval is the listing agent.
private_remarks: This is the cleanest bungalow on the green currently. Sellers raised two children here and have already moved in with family in town; they can close quickly. A small easement for the path is on the survey and has never been an issue.

name: 6 Sash Lane
amenities: Side porch|Updated bath|Garden shed|Near the landing
summary: A smaller Ferry Green bungalow, now under contract.
body:
6 Sash Lane went under contract after its second weekend on the market. The public sheet stays up so you can see what has recently traded on the Green.

It is a two-bedroom bungalow with a side porch and a short walk to the landing.
private_remarks: Under contract at $348,000, slightly under list, with a mid-December closing. Inspection was clean. Do not discuss price with walk-ins; refer them to Priya.

name: 22 Casement Place
amenities: Facing the courthouse lawn|Original stair|Roof deck behind the parapet|Cellar storage
summary: A brick townhouse on the east row, facing the courthouse lawn, with a hidden roof deck behind the parapet.
body:
22 Casement Place is in the only brick row the square ever got. The front rooms look onto the lawn; the kitchen is at the back, toward a small yard and the alley.

The third floor was opened into a main bedroom with its own bath, and a roof deck sits behind the parapet, out of sight from the street.

The office is two doors down. Weekday showings are easy to arrange by phone.
private_remarks: Rowan's listing. The roof deck flashing was redone in 2024. Sellers are downsizing to a mill loft and would like a single close if a buyer is in one of our other listings. Flexible on dates.

name: 8 Courthouse Square
amenities: Flat over the bookstore|Square windows|Shared street entrance|No interior stairs for the living floor
summary: A two-bedroom flat over the bookstore, coming to market the week after Thanksgiving.
body:
8 Courthouse Square is the flat above the bookstore, two doors from our window. It will be listed the week after Thanksgiving.

The living floor is all on one level, with two bedrooms at the back. The entrance is shared with the shop; there is a modest association for the stair and the roof.

Call the office if you want to hear when the first showing is scheduled.
private_remarks: Coming after Thanksgiving. Tenant (the bookseller's sister) is already out. Kitchen is dated. Price is set to attract a first-time buyer or someone who wants to walk to work on the square.

name: 72 Maple Street
summary: Sold in September, over list, after nine days on the market. A West Common foursquare.
body:
72 Maple Street was listed in August and went under contract in nine days, then closed at a little over the asking price.

We keep recent sales on the site so you can see what has actually traded, not just what is asking.
private_remarks: Closed at $455,000. Two offers. Buyers were already in our client group. Do not quote the offer count in public remarks.

name: 4 Orchard End
amenities: Kitchen ell|Older core|Garden and a small barn
summary: Sold in August. An older farmhouse on Orchard End, sitting at an angle to the later street.
body: 4 Orchard End is one of the farmhouses the 1912 plat grew up around. It closed in August, a little under list, after a longer market time than the foursquares on the same block.
private_remarks: Took longer because of the septic-to-sewer history, which was already resolved but scared a first-round buyer. Final price $390,000.

name: 31 Fenwater Walk
amenities: Near the mill bridge|Original stair|Small back yard
summary: Sold in October, a little over list. A mill cottage on Fenwater Walk, close to the bridge.
body: 31 Fenwater Walk is a standard Reach cottage that drew two offers and closed over list in October.
private_remarks: Closed $305,000. Both offers were from buyers already looking in the Reach with Ned.

name: 14 Gable Court
summary: Sold in July, a little under list. A ridge cape on a quiet court off Ridge Lane.
body: 14 Gable Court sold in July after a month on the market, a little under the asking price. Useful as a recent comparable for 110 Ridge Lane, which is listed now.
private_remarks: Closed $519,000. Appraisal came in at list; the concession was for a roof credit. Roof has since been done by the buyers, for what it's worth on a tour of 110.

name: 55 West Common
siding: Brick on the first, cream above
summary: A corner foursquare on West Common, now under contract.
body: 55 West Common is a slightly larger foursquare on a corner, with brick on the first story. It went under contract in late October and remains on the site until it closes.
private_remarks: Under contract at $469,000. Closing the first week of December. Inspection items were minor. If it breaks, tell Evan before anyone else.

name: 2 Brick Kiln Row
amenities: End of the row|Original windows on the street|Alley behind|A short walk to the mill
summary: The smallest cottage currently for sale in the Reach: two bedrooms, a steep gable, and an end-of-row side yard.
body:
2 Brick Kiln Row is the end cottage in a row of four. It is the most affordable active listing we have right now, and it is honest about its size.

The side yard is the advantage of an end unit. The rooms are small, the stair is steep, and the windows on the street side are original.

Listed this week. Call the office to see it; the first open house is Saturday.
private_remarks: Priced to move. The kitchen is the weak point and should be called out on the first walk-through so nobody is surprised. Cash or a renovation loan will have an easier time than a conservative conventional appraisal.
